# Composition test: results (generated by composition/analyze.py)

Predictions were recorded first, in [PREDICTIONS.md](PREDICTIONS.md). Networks: the study's μP MLP (width 128), Adam with learning rate 1e-3, minibatch 64, 20000 steps, d = 30, 3 seeds; square loss on the real-valued targets. 'coef' = test-set Fourier coefficient of the network output (target value 0.5 for every term).
